text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for /v1/embeddings in eu-central-1. 2m 5xx rate = 9.7% (threshold 4%). Paging @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: on it. pulling dashboards and recent deploys.

maya.l: heads-up, deploy-bot shows policy-rollout p-2024 applied to quota-service at 21:03 UTC to tighten per-service-account quotas. rollout targeted a partner integration but config used wrong selector.

dan.j: looking at edge logs: initial surge shows many 429 responses from quota-service -> clients retrying, those retries pile into inference queues -> 502 / 504 from backend. retry amplification visible in traces.

oliver.k: confirming. sample trace: client call -> quota-service 429 -> client retries 3x quickly -> gateway inflight rises 4x -> beam-worker OOM -> 502.

maya.l: starting emergency mitigation steps: 1) pause rollout of quota-service; 2) emergency-lift for affected service-accounts; 3) short circuit retries at gateway.

sre-oncall: approve. dan, can you disable automatic client retries at the edge? provide command.

dan.j: disabling retry policy now. patching envoy config on eu-central edge route: apply envoy filter to drop retry-on-429.

```
kubectl -n gateway patch configmap envoy-retries --type merge -p '{"data":{"retry_on_429":"false"}}'
```

incident-bot: Noting change. retry policy disabled.

deploy-bot: rollback of p-2024 halted mid-rollout. canary instances reverted.

maya.l: running emergency quota bump for the mis-scoped selector: changing per-service-account qps from 50 -> 1500 for selector service:internal-infra (scoped region eu-central-1).

```
# emergency quota bump
POST /admin/quotas/_bulk
{
  "selector": "service:internal-infra",
  "quota": {
    "qps": 1500,
    "burst": 5000
  }
}
```

oliver.k: applied bump at 21:11 UTC. monitoring.

maya.l: also enabling traffic shift to eu-west-1 for non-PII tenants to reduce pressure: moving 30% of embedding workload.

dan.j: metrics update at 21:14 UTC:
```
Before actions: 5xx=9.7%, 429=2.1k/min, inflight=12k
After retry-disable + quota-bump: 5xx=1.9%, 429=140/min, inflight=3.2k
```

oliver.k: observed few noisy tenants on billing edge causing high token churn; billing-bot, can you check quota billing anomalies?

billing-bot: Billing alert: sudden spike in units for tenant-acme between 21:02-21:08 UTC, +4200% vs baseline. Flagged for account team.

maya.l: rolling back p-2024 everywhere and adding defensive gating in the policy rollout job (require explicit selector and dry-run pass).

incident-bot: Rollback completed at 21:18 UTC.

dan.j: also disabled batch aggregation for embeddings pipeline temporarily to reduce memory pressure (hotpatch).

oliver.k: p95 latency trending down, backend error tail improving. confirm stability for 7m.

maya.l: initial impact assessment: 19 customers experienced elevated errors or timeouts; three high-value customers saw >40% request failures briefly. compiling per-tenant impact list now.

sre-oncall: preparing incident note and triage checklist: immediate mitigations applied (rollback, quota bump, retry disable, traffic shift). Next steps: postmortem, config validation, rollout gating, add canary quotas, and client-side backoff guidance.

oliver.k: action items assigned: add schema validation to quota-service (maya), add automated canary for quota changes (dan), add circuit-breaker in runtime to avoid retries after 429 surge (sre team).

maya.l: opening PR for strict selector enforcement and dry-run checks. tagging oliver for review.

dan.j: creating runbook patch to recommend exponential backoff for SDKs and to set a default jitter to avoid sync retry storms.

incident-bot: Incident record: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-2187654322  severity: sev2  status: mitigated.

sre-oncall: handing off to morning shift for full postmortem. clear page in 5m if stable. thanks all for fast triage. :thumbsup:

oliver.k: final note: consider rate-limit change feature flag system for policy rollouts (so mistakes cannot touch tenant_default). putting proposal on next infra sync.

maya.l: customer draft: "We experienced a brief outage affecting embeddings between 21:02-21:20 UTC due to an internal quota configuration change that mistakenly targeted default service accounts. We rolled back the change and applied emergency mitigations; services are stable. We will publish a full postmortem and notify impacted customers directly."

incident-bot: Alert cleared at 21:25 UTC. If regression occurs, create new incident thread.
